user_role: palmux user who wants a new CLI's auth folder shared into every workspace container
entry_point: Settings panel → デプロイ (deploy) tab → 共有フォルダ (Shared Folders) section
state_diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Loading: open deploy tab (GET /api/deploy)
    Loading --> Empty: sharedDirs = []
    Loading --> Populated: sharedDirs = [..]
    Empty --> Adding: user types a path + clicks Add
    Populated --> Adding: user types a path + clicks Add
    Adding --> Populated: valid path -> list updates (pending)
    Adding --> InputError: path outside $HOME -> inline error, list unchanged
    InputError --> Adding: user edits path
    Populated --> Removing: user clicks remove on a row
    Removing --> Populated: row disappears (pending)
    Populated --> Saving: user clicks Apply (POST /api/deploy/apply)
    Empty --> Saving: user clicks Apply
    Saving --> Saved: 200 -> success toast, profile rewritten + live-propagated
    Saving --> SaveError: 4xx/5xx -> error banner, values retained

scenarios.description: User adds ~/.infisical as a shared folder and applies

steps.action: open Settings → デプロイ tab
steps.expected: 共有フォルダ section renders; current list shown (data-testid=shared-dirs-list); a ⚠ warning about exposure to all containers is visible (data-testid=shared-dirs-warning)

steps.action: type ~/.infisical into the add input (data-testid=shared-dir-input) and click Add (data-testid=shared-dir-add)
steps.expected: a new row /home/ubuntu/.infisical appears in the list (pending, not yet applied)
success toast; a follow-up GET /api/deploy shows workspace.sharedDirs contains /home/ubuntu/.infisical

steps.action: type /etc/passwd into the add input and click Add
steps.expected: inline error (data-testid=shared-dir-error) 'パスは $HOME 配下のみ許可されます'; list unchanged; Apply not required
success toast; GET /api/deploy shows the entry gone

response_fields.workspace: { sharedDirs: string[] }  — NEW; absolute host paths (~ expanded)

endpoint_contracts.notes: Read internal/deploy DeployView + config.MasterConfig; add WorkspaceSection{ SharedDirs []string `toml:"shared_dirs" json:"sharedDirs"` }.

response_fields.message: string  — e.g. 'shared folders updated; N running container(s) refreshed'

endpoint_contracts.notes: class=workspace applies in-process: rewrite palmux-shared profile + propagate device add/remove to running incus containers (no palmux2 restart). $HOME-scope validation → 400 with {error} for out-of-home paths.
